pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Say Saum has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   C. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   B. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   D. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   D. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Stories of Prophets: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Taqwa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Tawakkul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. B — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. B — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Stories of Prophets:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Taqwa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Tawakkul; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
